That’s the dream I’ll defend as Governor.

Disgusting antisemitic rhetoric. Republican and Democrat, Florida and nationwide — we have to call this kind of hatred out when we see it. 

I hope national Democrats agree that this is completely unacceptable.

As Governor, I'll defend Florida from the failed Democrat policies that destroyed California, and make sure we never become @GavinNewsom’s failed state.

Florida is winning. Let's keep it that way.

The Castro regime murdered innocent Americans, and Cuban Americans have never forgotten.

Raúl Castro should not spend another day protected by the communist regime he helped build.

Indict him. Extradite him. Put him on trial in Miami, where the victims’ families and the Cuban exile community can finally look this evil in the eye and demand justice.

No more excuses for communist murderers.

Thank you to the Timber Pines Republican Club for the warm welcome and great conversation! 

It was an honor to share my vision for keeping Florida free, safe, and affordable.

Great morning with @ErikaDonalds at Sheriff @ChrisNocco’s Shotgun Shootout with some of Florida’s finest. 

Grateful for Sheriff Nocco and all our law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to protect our communities.

I am proud to stand with the strongest conservative fighters in Congress who deliver for our country every single day.

Honored to have the endorsement of @RepMaggard. Randy has been on the front lines fighting for our conservative values in the Florida House, and knows what it takes to deliver real results for Floridians. I'm proud to have him in our corner. 

I look forward to working together to Defend the Florida Dream!
Happy birthday to my friend and America’s Chief of Staff @SusieWiles!

Our kids’ futures are more important than party lines. Good to see a second Democrat Governor opt into @realdonaldtrump’s school-choice tax credit program.

Now: will @iamwesmoore and @JoshShapiroPA put parents and students first, or back down to their progressive base?

10 TRUTHS ABOUT FLORIDA

1. We don't do income tax.
2. We don't do sanctuary cities.
3. We don't do mask mandates.
4. We don't do men in girls' sports.
5. We don't do soft-on-crime state attorney.
6. We don't do CRT in classrooms.
7. We don't do squatters' rights.
8. We don't do open borders.
9. We don't apologize for any of it.
10. And we're not going to start now.

The red-blooded spirit that built America is the same spirit that will keep her free. As Governor, I'll stand with President Trump to keep Florida safe, affordable, and free.

The Golden Age starts now. 🇺🇸
